representations.train: Generated representations of ranked legitimate Tranco domains: https://<domain> for 100% and https://www.<domain> for the deterministic ~30% subset. These are NOT observed browser URLs.
representations.holdout: Generated representations of held-out Tranco domains: https://<domain> and https://www.<domain> for every domain. Never used for fitting, threshold selection, feature selection, or hyperparameter tuning.

pre_training_gate.note: num_dots/num_subdomains/num_slashes retain high univariate AUC because malicious Kaggle URLs contain deep paths and subdomains. This is a real dataset property, not an HTTPS label proxy; the formal gate is the uses_https AUC plus the HTTPS class balance.

parent_child.note: Hostname-only grouping without a Public Suffix List. Parent/child overlaps are reported, not claimed to be zero.

leakage_audit.note: Tranco domains overlapping any Kaggle hostname (exact, parent, or child) were excluded before selection. Hostname grouping is not registrable-domain grouping because no Public Suffix List is used.

external_holdout.note: Generated representations of ranked Tranco domains, not observed browser URLs. Popularity is not a guarantee of safety.

sanity_suite.note: Sanity strings only; never used for fitting, tuning, or accuracy.
